provenance.note: The intake reports a perceived deviation and silently assumes a single reference cup.

value.top_outcome: The drinker consistently enjoys the cup, judged against a reference they declare.

provenance.note: Machine, extraction, home routine and experienced cup are offered as rungs; the human chooses the level.

value.question: Which espresso reference is the drinker comparing against, and by how much does the cup deviate from it?
Why does extraction on the home machine vary from shot to shot?
Is the coffee as bought fit for espresso?
Does the home routine, including water and maintenance, keep the machine inside its operating range?

rationale_summaries: The complaint bundles several deviations (taste, crema, consistency) into one sentence, so no single cause can be tested against it.
The phrase 'Italian espresso' names a reference that is not one specification; published Italian parameter sets differ on temperature, time and dose.
The frame cannot be chosen until the symptom is specified as IS and IS NOT across what, where, when and extent, because those contrasts decide which branch is worth analysing.

uncertainties.summary: Which reference the drinker means is unknown; candidate parameter sets disagree.
It is unknown whether one deviation or several are being reported, and whether they share a cause.

missing_information.summary: What deviates: taste (sour, bitter, flat), crema, strength or consistency, and in which shots it does not.
Where it occurs: the same coffee on other equipment, or other coffee on the same equipment.
When it occurs: first shot versus later shots, coffee age, and changes such as a new bag or missed maintenance.
Extent: every shot or some, and the measured shot time, cup quantity and crema persistence against the declared reference.

warnings: No machine, coffee or maintenance intervention is proposed; the symptom must be specified before causal analysis begins.
